heading: Today
text: Patchy fog, then some morning sunshine.  Clouds thickening in the afternoon through NY and the St. Lawrence, with a shower possible late spreading east, north of Rt. 2.  Warm.  Highs in the upper 60s to low 70s.  Winds light, becoming south to southwest near 10 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds, with a rising chance of showers north, becoming likely in the St. Lawrence Valley by midnight, spreading south through the Adirondacks and to Rt. 2 by morning. Lows in the 50s to low 60s.  Winds south to southwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west, diminishing after midnight.

heading: Friday
text: Showers from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 north, a rising chance south, with a good chance in the afternoon, while diminishing north.  Highs in the 60s north, and 70s south.  Winds south to southwest, shifting to the northwest less than 10 mph.
